meta.title: Validation gates — a strategy may only go live (and appear on the leaderboard) after passing ALL gates
meta.note: Gates are designed to remove luck and data-mining bias: official data only, out-of-sample testing with a private (unseen) segment, statistical significance of win rate vs the price-implied break-even, minimum sample sizes, CLV as the skill metric, multiple-comparison correction, correlation control, and bankroll survival rules.

rows.name: Data integrity gate
rows.rule: Every input must come from an official verified source listed in data/sources.json (NFL official stats/NGS/injuries/schedule, NWS, licensed-sportsbook official pages, state regulator). No third-party or unverifiable data. Any value that cannot be confirmed from an official source is left blank and flagged (data/flagged.json).
rows.pass_criteria: 100% of inputs mapped to source IDs; zero unverified hard inputs

rows.name: Out-of-sample / holdout gate (anti-overfitting)
rows.rule: Backtest on past seasons with a strict time split: train on seasons ≤ T, validate on season T+1 as a private (never-tuned) segment — mirroring the public/private leaderboard split used by Kaggle competitions; never tune on the holdout. Treat future-information leakage as an automatic fail.
rows.pass_criteria: Holdout performance reported separately; no parameter tuned on holdout

rows.name: Skill-vs-luck significance gate
rows.rule: Test the strategy's win rate against the break-even rate implied by the price (e.g., 110/210 = 52.38% at -110) using the one-proportion binomial z-test; require p < 0.05 one-sided that true win rate > break-even, with N large enough that min{N·p0, N·(1−p0)} ≥ 5 (N > 30)
rows.pass_criteria: z ≥ 1.645 at α = 0.05 vs price-implied break-even on the holdout set

rows.name: Minimum sample-size gate
rows.rule: Do not promote a strategy on fewer than the N required to detect the target edge δ at α = 0.05 / power 0.80, computed with the NIST sample-size formula for proportions; short win streaks are luck, not skill
rows.pass_criteria: N ≥ required N(δ) for the claimed edge on holdout

rows.name: CLV gate (primary skill metric)
rows.rule: Strategy must show positive average closing line value on the holdout set (bet price vs closing price at the same book, same market/handicap); CLV converges faster than profit and is the accepted skill indicator; record CLV for every bet
rows.pass_criteria: Mean CLV > 0 on holdout (and ideally statistically distinguishable from 0)

rows.name: Multiple-comparison / data-mining gate
rows.rule: If the strategy was selected from many candidate signals/parameterizations, apply Bonferroni correction (per-test α/g across g tests) to the significance gate G3 so the family-wise false-positive rate stays ≤ 5%

rows.name: Correlation & bankroll gate
rows.rule: For parlays/combos: measure pairwise Pearson r between leg signals (NIST formula) and reject legs above the |r| threshold or flagged as related contingencies by the book; for all strategies: fractional-Kelly staking so that the worst realistic parlay loss keeps bankroll drawdown within the pre-set limit; no bet may risk more than the staking cap
rows.pass_criteria: All combo legs pass correlation screen; simulated max drawdown within limit under Kelly sizing

rows.name: Execution & settlement gate
rows.rule: Bets are placed only at licensed sportsbooks at posted propositions; settlement verified against official league stats (regulator requires grading from official league records); every bet logged with timestamp, price, closing price, and result
rows.pass_criteria: 100% of bets have complete logs; settlement matches official stats
